title: In basic training when President Kennedy is assassinated
description: Larry remembers being about a month into basic training when President Kennedy was shot. The assassination was November 22, 1963 — almost exactly a month after his October 28 induction. His own memory, offered unprompted in a 2026 phone call, independently corroborates the DD-214's 1963 induction date over the old family estimate of 1964.
researchNotes: From the 2026-08-12 phone call (research/interviews/2026-08-12-call-notes.md). The location of basic training is still unknown — a question for a future conversation. A remembered national event is a strong anchor: everyone of his generation remembers where they were that day. Location established 2026-08-23 (giscus-vn-0024-c18119890): basic training was at Fort Ord, Monterey Bay, California — "Was there from September until probably January." Note the tension with the DD-214: Larry places the start in September 1963, while the form puts induction at 28 October 1963 (data/timeline/1963-10-28-inducted.json, confirmed). Both stand; a late-October induction fits "about a month into basic" when Kennedy was shot on 22 November, so the September may be the memory rounding backward.
